verdict.rationale: Workable documents a token-authenticated REST API (v3) that can be called from a terminal, which allows scripted, headless operation of core recruiting data such as jobs and candidates. It also documents an MCP server for programmatic access. However, nothing in the evidence shows CI-oriented tooling, and the docs send integrators to their live account with no test tenant, test keys or test base URL, which limits safe automated pipeline use. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, sandbox/test environment for non-production runs, published OpenAPI spec, API changelog/deprecation policy, independent corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
